items.title: Epic announces game jam where you have to use AI, then walks back the requirement
items.excerpt: Epic's 2026 Epic AI MegaJam for Unreal Engine (theme revealed November 11, thousands of dollars in prizes) originally said in its FAQ that entrants had to use AI. After backlash Epic said it was a mistake and that you can use as little or as much AI as you want.

items.title: Japan Actors Union pushes for heavy restrictions on AI copying dead actors
items.excerpt: The roughly 2,600-member Japan Actors Union, which includes game voice actors, put out generative-AI guidelines that require consent at every stage and disclosure whenever a performer's voice is used for AI. It stops short of a ban but sets heavy limits on AI copies of deceased actors.

items.title: Best WoW Forever add-ons to avoid AI slop
items.excerpt: AI-generated add-ons are flooding CurseForge for World of Warcraft: Forever as low-effort near-duplicates that raise testing, maintenance, security and Blizzard TOS concerns. Destructoid points players to handcrafted alternatives such as Questie and Dialogue UI.

items.title: UE5 Motion Matching With 900+ Animations, Built by an AI Agent
items.excerpt: CodeFizz's editor agent assembled an Unreal Engine 5 Motion Matching setup for unarmed, rifle, pistol and shotgun locomotion, picking more than 900 animations from a 1,700-asset library and building the chooser tables, then tested the result. The creator says none of it was built by hand. It is a vendor demo with a small audience (about 175 views).

items.title: Microsoft And Epic Games Suddenly Agree That AI Is Theft
items.excerpt: Kotaku argues that Microsoft and Epic, both openly promoting AI in their own game development, are now trying to have AI-made decompilations, vibe-coded browser ports and recomps taken down. Opinion/analysis rather than a new action.

items.title: The AI PS5 Homebrew Gold Rush Is Why GTA 6 Can't Be Pirated
items.excerpt: AI-assisted reverse-engineering with Claude has set off a PS5 homebrew boom, including disc-based PS2/PS3 emulation tools, and has split the scene. One hacker reported a big hypervisor exploit to Sony, which the community blames for closing the door on GTA 6 piracy.

items.title: SonicFox Backs Out Of A Gaming Convention Over An AI-Generated Promo
items.excerpt: Fighting-game pro SonicFox ended their contract with Nexcon 2026 after the convention's promo flyer used AI to generate their likeness and those of other guests. The organizer admitted using AI and asked them to reconsider. Edge of the window (about 335.7h old).
